title: 12V Distribution Bus Bar Auto Boat Marine Power 6 Way Terminal Block Bus Bar
body_html:
Feature:

High quality 6 way M4 terminal busbar with 2 x M6 terminal studs for power connection.

Supplied with washer and split ring vibration resistant washer and cover to prevent accidental shorting.

Suitable for power distribution use in 12V applications including boats, mobile homes and campervans.

Supplied with 2 x screws to secure into panels.



Specification:

Number of Circuits : 6

Termination (Circuit Connection) : M4 Nut and Stud

Termination (Power Distribution) : M6 Nut and Stud

Maximum Current Rating: 25A DC per Circuit (150A Maximum)

Maximum Voltage Rating: 48V DC

Mounting Hole Centres : 105mm

Overall Size : 120mm (L) x 20mm (W) x 43mm (H)

Material : Plastic + Metal



Package Included:

1 x 6 Way Busbar Wiring Block

2 x screws
